-82.94660,40.14040.name: Reproductive Gynecology & Infertility-Westerville
-82.94660,40.14040.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: David M. Nash, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-94.42650,35.38803.name: Arkansas Colleges of Health Education - Research Institute Health and Wellness Center
-94.42650,35.38803.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-0.14828,51.52251.name: Harley Street Fertility Clinic
-0.14828,51.52251.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-84.32805,33.79961.name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
-84.32805,33.79961.state: 1600 Clifton Road N.E., Atlanta, Georgia, 30329, United States
-84.32805,33.79961.company: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
-84.32805,33.79961.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 533 SqM. Operational or announced: 1988. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-116.99100,32.99000.name: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance — Frozen Zoo
-116.99100,32.99000.desc: Cell lines from more than a thousand species, frozen since 1972, and the reason the cloned ferrets and horses were possible at all — the cells used were banked decades before anyone could do anything with them. It is the clearest case for collecting material whose use has not yet been invented, and there are only a handful of such collections in the world.

0.18700,52.07900.name: Wellcome Sanger Institute
0.18700,52.07900.state: Hinxton, UK — Sanger, Wellcome Genome Campus
0.18700,52.07900.desc: One of the largest genome sequencing centres in the world, publicly funded, which sequenced a third of the human genome reference and now runs biodiversity genomics at scale. Its output is released openly, which is why so much downstream work is possible.

-2.23300,53.46800.name: UK Biobank
-2.23300,53.46800.desc: Half a million volunteers with genomic, health and lifestyle data, accessible to researchers including commercial ones. It is the largest resource of its kind assembled with explicit consent, and the terms of commercial access are the ongoing argument.
